task.name: pick_place_chem_ep2
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the vial and place it in the left empty slot on the rack. Then use the right arm to grasp the test tube and place it in the right empty slot on the rack.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the vial.
3. Move the left arm to align with the left empty slot on the rack.
4. Release the gripper to place the vial into the left empty slot on the rack.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the test tube.
7. Move the right arm to align with the right empty slot on the rack.
8. Release the gripper to place the test tube into the right empty slot on the rack.
